acceptance.source: docs/product-kit.md, docs/seo-and-agent-discovery.md, docs/design-language.md, and the approved localhost specimen brief
outcomes: Astro renders a substantial monochrome portfolio and design-system specimen.
Product accents remain scoped to product identity and action roles.
The design profile stays machine-readable and deterministically validated.
Each public product page carries plain-English context, crawlable metadata, and static content.
The approved accessibility release target is a Lighthouse score of at least 0.90.
invariants: The prototype remains static and performs no Neon or production writes.
The base palette remains black, white, and gray.
Product accents do not become generic semantic status colors.
Cloudflare, domain, and analytics actions remain opt-in and credential-gated.
Analytics defaults to a no-op provider and emits no OpenPanel network surface when disabled.
The embedded demo keeps its state local and its responsive surface inside the product page.
Important product meaning remains visible in HTML and is not dependent on JavaScript or media.
forbiddenOutcomes: SSR, database access, external deployment, or secret use is introduced by the prototype.
A validation command performs a Cloudflare, domain, analytics, or billing write.
Visitor changes in the demo are represented as production data or persisted outside the mockup.
Visual readiness is reported without rendered review.
